decisions.reason: Because the chart visualization plugin disappeared from the website after its 2018 launch, management would read this as results falling below aspiration and would reallocate resources to stronger geospatial components and new development.

The GIS solution platform moved from a general mention in 2018 to a dedicated page in 2019, which signals acceptable performance relative to aspiration and justifies continued support for this strategically important core-near offering.

The mobile field data capture software remained prominently presented across multiple years in an area close to the firm's established business, so management would see enough traction and strategic fit to keep it.
The search extension stayed on a dedicated page and received a version update in 2019, indicating ongoing customer use and performance at or above aspiration, so it should be retained.
